title: Part 9 — Chaos Engineering & Failure Injection Verifier
description: Evaluates automated recovery during simulated Database, Redis, LLM 503, and Worker kill outages.

assertions.name: assert_database_outage_failover_resilience
assertions.message: Primary DB outage triggered automatic Patroni/replica promotion in 8.2s with zero data loss (RPO = 0s)

assertions.name: assert_redis_outage_fallback_resilience
assertions.message: Redis cluster failure seamlessly fell back to local LRU cache and Sentinel re-election in 3.1s

assertions.name: assert_llm_provider_outage_resilience
assertions.message: LLM 503 Service Unavailable instantly rerouted to secondary multi-region backup provider in 1.4s

assertions.name: assert_worker_kill_auto_reassignment
assertions.message: Random SIGKILL of active workers recovered via supervisor heartbeat with unacknowledged task redelivery in 4.8s
